coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (plot y-axis shows g_agamma in units of 10^-11 GeV^-1; multiplier applied)
notes: Fermi-LAT search for ALP-induced prompt gamma-ray bursts from 20 extragalactic core-collapse SNe (type Ib/c). Stacked 95% CL limit excludes g_agamma > (2.6+2.0-0.7)e-11 GeV^-1 for m_a < 3e-10 eV, assuming 10 M_sun progenitors, NiCo optical light-curve model, JF12 GMF, and that at least one SN was in the LAT field of view (P=88.5%). Paper states limits extend to arbitrarily low masses since P_agamma is mass-independent for m_a <~ 0.5 neV, so the flat bound is encoded from 1e-12 eV to the stated 3e-10 eV upper validity edge; limits degrade above that (no tabulated values, only Fig. 2). Not a dark-matter haloscope, so no local DM density assumed.
